summary: Executed Fix Plan D1 (logs/small fixes) + D2 (2FA/passkey/admin hardening) pure-unit regression at tests/test_fixplan_d1_d2_logs_mfa.py per review request. All 9 tests pass. Covered: S4 URL/query secret redaction + httpx/httpcore WARNING; S5 Telegram webhook secret in header (literal 'hook' path, legacy path fallback); S8 production refuses to start without RESEND_API_KEY and activation/reset links never logged (dev-only field gated by is_production); S9 bug routes admin-by-role only (no email heuristics); D2 S1 passkey enrol/complete/delete require step-up + pinned WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN wins and production refuses unpinned (503); D2 S2 /2fa/enroll requires current password + Settings.jsx wire-up with data-testid='enable-2fa-password' and email notice on enable; D2 S6 ops/authority/infra admin role checks moved to _admin_ok helper + ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED + forced promotion requires 'admin_promote' step-up; D2 S10 revoke_user_api_keys called from password_change/password_reset/account_suspended + enterprise refuses suspended owners; D2 S11 VPS rebuild/delete step-up ('vps_destroy'). Run cmd: `cd /app/backend && DB_NAME='' python -m pytest tests/test_fixplan_d1_d2_logs_mfa.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` → 9 passed in 0.42s. The STOIC_TESTS_ALLOW_DB_NAME knob suggested in the request is NOT needed here — these are pure-unit tests that read files and inspect source; the file's docstring explicitly says `run with DB_NAME=''`.
critical_code_review_comments: test_fixplan_d1_d2_logs_mfa.py builds asyncio event loops inline (new_event_loop().run_until_complete) rather than using pytest-asyncio — fine for a sync test, but if more async checks are added, prefer @pytest.mark.asyncio for proper teardown of the loop and finalisers.

test_s6 strips the literal admin-helper check with `.replace('if not u or u.get("role") != "admin":', '')` before asserting no raw role strings remain — this is brittle: if the helper's signature changes (e.g., different whitespace, variable name), the test will spuriously fail. Consider calling _admin_ok directly or scanning AST for Compare nodes instead.

test_s2 asserts frontend content with hard-coded JSX fragment `api.post("/auth/2fa/enroll", { current_password: enrollPw })`. Any formatter re-flow (Prettier, comma, spacing) silently breaks the regression. A regex check (e.g., `re.search(r'/auth/2fa/enroll.*current_password', fe)`) would be more robust.

D1 S8 production boot guard is only asserted via grep of 'APP_ENV=production requires RESEND_API_KEY' in server.py — the actual startup refusal path (SystemExit / crash) is not exercised. If the string is left but the raise is removed, this test still passes. Consider a boot-time unit test that imports server with monkeypatched env and expects a RuntimeError/SystemExit.

Related D1/A/B/C fix-plan files (a3_a4, a6, b1) need a running DB and raise 54 collection errors under DB_NAME=''. They are correctly outside the scope of this request, but the preview backend currently has no mode where ALL fix-plan tests collect together — each file has its own DB requirement. A unified pytest marker ('unit' vs 'http' vs 'live') with a conftest skip default would simplify CI.
